latestVersion.changelog:
Best-ai-video-creator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generates professional, scene-structured video scripts from text, ideas, or scripts.
- Supports export, credits check, upload, and status actions via easy command routing.
- Integrates with NemoVideo cloud rendering APIs for seamless session management and video creation.
- Handles various video styles (social, explainer, product, etc.) with built-in visual/narration/scene suggestions.
- Full error handling for tokens, sessions, credits, files, and export permissions.
- No editing experience required — just describe your video need and get a ready-to-produce script.
